sections.label: Multimodal Transport Bill 2020
sections.summary: The Multimodal Transport Bill 2020 will set up a new Act to give effect to the ASEAN Framework Agreement on Multimodal Transport.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: The Multimodal Transport Bill 2020 will set up a new Act to give effect to the ASEAN Framework Agreement on Multimodal Transport.

sections.label: Singapore ratifying ASEAN Multimodal Transport Agreement
sections.summary: Singapore completed ratification of two ASEAN agreements in 2019 and is introducing the Multimodal Transport Bill to facilitate ratifying the ASEAN Framework Agreement on Multimodal Transport later this year.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: In 2019, Singapore completed the ratification of the ASEAN Framework Agreement on the Facilitation of Goods in Transit and the ASEAN Framework Agreement on the Facilitation of Inter-State Transport.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: We are now introducing the Multimodal Transport Bill, to facilitate Singapore ratifying the ASEAN Framework Agreement on Multimodal Transport later this year.

sections.label: Bill's four key areas
sections.summary: The Bill covers four key areas: registration with the Singapore Competent National Body, issuance of Multimodal Transport Document, liabilities of Multimodal Transport Operators, and duties and liabilities of Consignors.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: The Bill covers four key areas, which are: (a) Registration with the Singapore Competent National Body; (b) Issuance of Multimodal Transport Document; (c) Liabilities of Multimodal Transport Operators; and (d) Duties and Liabilities of Consignors.

sections.label: Land Transport Authority as Competent National Body
sections.summary: For Singapore, the Land Transport Authority will be the Competent National Body.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: For Singapore, the Land Transport Authority will be the Competent National Body.

sections.label: Registration certificate validity and renewal
sections.summary: Once issued, the registration certificate is valid for one year and can be renewed.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: Once issued, the registration certificate is valid for one year and can be renewed.

sections.label: Supporting local logistics companies under AFAMT
sections.summary: A Member says Singapore's participation in AFAMT is relevant, the market is small, and a registry of recognised operators could boost logistics, hoping qualifying criteria is not too onerous.

sentences.speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: In this era, Singapore's active participation in the ASEAN Framework Agreement on Multimodal Transport (AFAMT) has become more relevant than ever.

sentences.speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: But Singapore is a small market and we should strike while the iron is hot, do more to help our local logistics companies to spread their wings and encourage them to look beyond the shores.

sentences.speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: I note that the implementation of a registry of multimodal transport operators recognised under AFAMT could be one of the ways to give our logistics sector a boost.

sentences.speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: I understand that some minimum conditions set by the AFAMT must be met, but overall, I hope the domestic qualifying criteria is not too onerous, or that the Government would help companies with it.

sections.label: Raising company standards in registry
sections.summary: The speaker urges the Ministry to help raise standards across companies that opt to join the registry.

sentences.speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: On the other hand, we want our companies to be recognised for their abilities and reliability.

sentences.speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: I urge the Ministry to extend assistance to raise standards across the companies that opt to join the registry.

sections.label: ASEAN recognition of Multimodal Transport Document
sections.summary: The Multimodal Transport Document is recognised by all ASEAN member states.

sentences.speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: The Multimodal Transport Document is recognised by all ASEAN member states.

sections.label: AFAMT facilitates trade and integration
sections.summary: AFAMT facilitates trade and greater regional economic integration by streamlining multimodal transport of goods among ASEAN member countries.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: By streamlining the multimodal transport of goods among ASEAN member countries, AFAMT facilitates trade and greater regional economic integration.

sections.label: AFAMT strengthens logistics hub position
sections.summary: The AFAMT will strengthen Singapore's position as a logistics hub and help build a more agile and dynamic logistics network with the region.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: The AFAMT will strengthen our position as a logistics hub and help build a more agile and dynamic logistics network with the region.

sections.label: AFAMT sustainability goal
sections.summary: One goal of the AFAMT is to enhance the sustainability of multimodal transport operations.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: One goal of the AFAMT is to enhance the sustainability of multimodal transport operations.

sections.label: Support for registered multimodal transport Bill
sections.summary: The speaker supports the Bill enabling registered multimodal transport service providers to move goods throughout ASEAN with a single Multimodal Transport Document, without submitting different documents for each jurisdiction.

sentences.speaker: Mr Don Wee (Chua Chu Kang)
sentences.text: (In Mandarin):    I support this Bill which will enable registered multimodal transport service providers to move goods throughout ASEAN with a single Multimodal Transport Document.

sentences.speaker: Mr Don Wee (Chua Chu Kang)
sentences.text: Upon joining the registry of operators recognised by the ASEAN Framework Agreement on Multimodal Transport (AFAMT), they will no longer have to submit different documents for each jurisdiction.

sections.label: Logistics companies registry criteria
sections.summary: The passage states the qualifying criteria for logistics companies to join the Registry are as follows.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: First, the qualifying criteria for logistics companies to join the Registry are as follows.

sections.label: Special Drawing Rights amount
sections.summary: The passage states the intended amount is 80,000 Special Drawing Rights, approximately S$153,000 at current exchange rates.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: At the start, we intend to set this to be the equivalent of 80,000 Special Drawing Rights which is equivalent to approximately S$153,000, based on current exchange rates.

sections.label: Publishing liability insurance information
sections.summary: The passage states liability insurance information will be published on the registry website when the company registers with LTA.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: Mr Don Wee asked whether potential customers will know the amount of liability insurance that the company has.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: We will publish this information on the registry website when the company registers with LTA.

sections.label: ASEAN MTO liability regime
sections.summary: The passage states the Bill provides a common and consistent liability regime for MTOs across ASEAN.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: As for Mr Saktiandi’s question about protection and insurance for logistics companies, the Bill provides for a common and consistent liability regime for MTOs across ASEAN.
